title: Business true/false question pair
description: One file per pair in questions/<area>/<id>.yaml. scripts/validate.py enforces this schema plus content checks (negation-only pairs, duplicates, same-fact pairs, exam-style wording, dated figures, source drift).

id.description: Stable and never reused, even after retirement.

area.description: Same as the source article's domain and the folder name.

kind.description: What the pair teaches: what it is, who and when, how it works, evidence and critiques, in practice, or a dated number.

topic.description: The source article's title, shown after answering.

topic_type.description: The source article's ontology class (Framework, Theory, Person, Case, ...).

false_statement.description: A plausible twin: swaps a person, year, number, cause, effect or a neighbouring idea, not just adds 'not'.

explanation.description: Why the true statement is true and the false one is false.

as_of.description: Required for kind figure: the year or period the number is for, e.g. FY2024.

commit.description: Source repo HEAD when the pair was written or last verified.

blob.description: Git blob of the article at that point; a different blob means the article changed (drift).

supersedes.description: The retired pair this one replaced when a fact changed.
